title.en: red bull münchen – nürnberg, the derby.
title.de: red bull münchen – nürnberg, das derby.

line.en: the nürnberg ice tigers come to sap garden for a sunday afternoon derby, puck drop 16:30. come by 16:00.
line.de: die nürnberg ice tigers kommen am sonntagnachmittag ins sap garden, anpfiff 16:30. um 16:00 da sein.
line.tr: nürnberg ice tigers pazar öğleden sonra sap garden'a geliyor, buz hokeyi başlangıcı 16:30. 16:00'da orada ol.

sparks.why: EHC Red Bull München vs Nürnberg Ice Tigers, Sun 1.11 at SAP Garden, 16:30 per the in-muenchen.de event listing; the club's 2026/27 schedule gives 4:30 pm (redbullmuenchen.de, found in search; the page could not be opened). Sunday is All Saints' Day (Allerheiligen), a Bavarian public holiday.
